shared_or_similar_visual_information: An arrowhead attached to the end of a straight line.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: An arrowhead at one limit of a finite spatial dimension. Right image: The arrowhead orienting the positive direction of a coordinate axis.
Rationales: The coordinate arrow orients the axis used to read values. The dimension arrow identifies one limit of a finite geometric length, as shown by its opposite arrow and length label.
